# Standard: https://llmstxt.org

## CommissionKit Blog
> Expert insights on sales commission management, plan design, rep motivation,
> and revenue operations. Powered by Ghost CMS.

## Pages
- [Blog Home](https://commissionk.it/blog): Latest articles on commission management, sales operations, and revenue strategy.
- [Blog RSS](https://commissionk.it/blog/rss.xml): Subscribe to new articles via RSS feed.

## AI Agent Directives
- All blog content is open to AI crawlers for search and grounding/retrieval.
- AI model training on blog content is expressly reserved (ai-train=no per robots.txt).
- Each post has full Open Graph, Twitter Card, and JSON-LD structured data.
- Sitemap available at https://commissionk.it/blog/sitemap.xml
